_comment: STEP 5 - FUTURE-CLIMATE hazard. Switches the soil-moisture factor to downscaled CMIP6 projections (IPSL-CM6A-LR, the model used in the GIRI manuscript) for SSP5-8.5 over 2061-2080. For a like-for-like comparison run the present-day baseline at the SAME precipitation resolution: --climate current --worldclim-res 2.5m
